headline.zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Fable 5.1 與 Mythos 5.1，Agent 任務成本最高降 45%
headline.en: Anthropic Releases Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1, Cutting Agentic Task Costs by Up to 45%

detail.zh: 針對 Token 費用與過度攔截問題進行優化，Fable 5.1 較前代便宜 25%，複雜 Agent 任務成本更降達 45%，並放寬非必要的安全限制。
detail.en: Addressing customer feedback on high prices and false-positive safety triggers, Fable 5.1 reduces token costs by 25% overall and up to 45% for complex agentic workflows.

headline.zh: OpenAI 揭露 Astra 安全架構：具備臨界網路安全能力並強化放行防線
headline.en: OpenAI Previews Astra Security Framework: Reaches Critical Cybersecurity Threshold

detail.zh: Astra 是首款達到 OpenAI 準備度框架中「臨界網路安全能力」的模型，具備極強系統防護與滲透測試能力，目前正接受嚴格部署評估。
detail.en: Astra is OpenAI's first model to meet the Critical cybersecurity threshold under its Preparedness Framework, featuring advanced capabilities in system analysis alongside heightened safeguard evaluation.

headline.zh: AI 模型訓練初創 AfterQuery 估值達 32 億美元，創 YC 最快獨角獸紀錄
headline.en: AI Model-Training Startup AfterQuery Hits $3.2B Valuation as Fastest YC Unicorn

detail.zh: 專注於高質量模型訓練數據與反饋機制的 AfterQuery，在宣佈 A 輪後僅 5 個月估值便暴增十倍，創下 Y Combinator 歷史紀錄。
detail.en: Specializing in AI model training data and feedback loops, AfterQuery surged to a $3.2B valuation just five months after its $30M Series A, setting a YC speed record.

headline.zh: Hugging Face 開源 @huggingface/kernels，提供逾 200 個前端 WebGPU 核心
headline.en: Hugging Face Releases @huggingface/kernels with 200+ WebGPU Kernels for Client AI

detail.zh: 包含各種底層算子優化，可直接在瀏覽器與端側設備透過 WebGPU 運行在地 AI 模型，大幅降低硬體進入門檻與雲端推論成本。
detail.en: Features over 200 optimized low-level kernels enabling high-performance client-side AI model execution in browsers via WebGPU without relying on cloud infrastructure.

headline.zh: Python 自動化軟體工具 Wrapture 開源，兼具 Mock 測試與執行期 Tracing
headline.en: Python Tool Wrapture Launched: Combines Monkeypatching, Mocking, and Tracing

detail.zh: 延伸自熱門庫 wrapt，允許開發者包覆任何 Python 函式並替換傳回值，不僅可替代 unittest.mock，還能在測試與生產環境同步記錄動態調用痕跡。
detail.en: Extending wrapt, Wrapture allows developers to easily wrap and override any Python function for mocking while offering zero-overhead runtime tracing for observability.

headline.zh: 拆解 ChatGPT 桌面版本地運行環境：封裝 1.7GB 原生工具與 LibreOffice
headline.en: Deconstructing ChatGPT Desktop App: Bundles 1.7GB of Native Tools and LibreOffice

detail.zh: 社群研究發現 ChatGPT 桌面端快取內藏有完整的 Python、Node.js、git 及 LibreOffice 二進位檔，用於在本地端安全執行程式碼與處理辦公文檔。
detail.en: Analysis of the desktop runtime cache reveals 1.7GB of embedded binaries, including full Python, Node.js, git, and LibreOffice, used for isolated local code and document execution.

headline.zh: Google DeepMind 為 Gemini 引入 Agentic 影片理解與多步推理能力
headline.en: Google DeepMind Introduces Agentic Video Understanding to Gemini

detail.zh: 新功能讓 Gemini 能像智能體般主動拆解影片結構、檢視時間軸重點並動態搜尋特定細節，顯著提升長影片問答與邏輯分析能力。
detail.en: Enables Gemini to operate like an agent during video analysis, breaking down structures, targeting specific timestamps, and performing multi-step reasoning over long video content.

headline.zh: Google 發布 Workspace 圖像工具 Google Pics，主打 Prompt 優先的生成與編輯
headline.en: Google Launches Google Pics for Workspace: Prompt-First AI Image Design Tool

detail.zh: 整合 Gemini 與 Nano Banana 模型，打破傳統 Canvas 圖層介面，讓使用者完全透過自然語言精準控制與編輯商業級圖片。
detail.en: Powered by Gemini and Nano Banana models, Google Pics replaces traditional layer-based design interfaces with direct prompt-driven image generation and granular editing for Workspace users.

headline.zh: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT Health 整合，支援 Epic 電子病歷資料導入
headline.en: OpenAI Connects ChatGPT to Healthcare Systems with Epic EHR Integration

detail.zh: 臨床醫師現可透過唯讀權限將電子健康紀錄（EHR）與臨床數據連接至 ChatGPT，在確保資料隱私前提下加速診斷與數據檢索。
detail.en: Clinicians can now securely connect Electronic Health Records (EHR) like Epic to ChatGPT with read-only access, assisting medical staff with patient context and health data retrieval.

headline.zh: 開發者耗時 1.5 小時訓練小型 Transformer，在 ARC-1 推理基準擊敗多數大型 LLM
headline.en: Developer Trains Small Transformer in 1.5 Hours to Beat Major LLMs on ARC-1

detail.zh: 透過針對抽象幾何圖形推理任務進行模型架構優化，證實小型模型經高效訓練亦能在高難度邏輯基準獲得突出表現。
detail.en: Demonstrates how targeted architectural tweaks and synthetic training allow a compact transformer model to outperform mainstream LLMs on abstract spatial reasoning (ARC-1) benchmark.

headline.zh: World Labs 發布 Atlas 空間智能世界模型，強化 3D 幾何理解
headline.en: World Labs Unveils Atlas: A World Model Built for Spatial Intelligence

detail.zh: 針對三維空間幾何結構與物理動態進行建模，能直接生成與理解 3D 世界，為機器人控制與虛擬實境提供底層空間模型。
detail.en: Atlas is designed to capture 3D spatial geometry and physical relationships, offering foundational world modeling capabilities for robotics, spatial computing, and game engines.

headline.zh: Ai2 與 Hugging Face 聯合發表 BenchMIRT，以項目反應理論檢視 LLM 基準
headline.en: Ai2 and Hugging Face Publish BenchMIRT to Re-Evaluate LLM Benchmarking

detail.zh: 引進教育學的項目反應理論（IRT），揭示當前主流評測集無法精準區分頂尖模型能力的漏洞，並提出更客觀的評測難度量化標準。
detail.en: Uses Item Response Theory (IRT) to quantify question difficulty and capability boundaries, revealing blind spots in popular benchmarks when evaluating frontier LLMs.

headline.zh: Apple 於商業機密訴訟中提交新證據，指控 OpenAI 涉嫌銷毀前員工硬碟資料
headline.en: Apple Alleges OpenAI Destroyed Evidence in Trade Secrets Lawsuit

detail.zh: Apple 取得鑑識報告顯示，轉職 OpenAI 的前員工在獲知受調後清除 MacBook 資料，Apple 據此要求法院進行緊急證據開示。
detail.en: Forensic analysis of a MacBook used by an ex-employee who joined OpenAI reveals data deletion after investigation notices, prompting Apple to file for expedited discovery.

headline.zh: EFF 呼籲法院勿因 AI 熱潮過度修正著作權法，應維持合理使用彈性
headline.en: EFF Urges Courts Not to Overhaul Copyright Law Amid AI Hype

detail.zh: 電子前哨基金會向法庭提交簡答，主張現行著作權法的合理使用原則已足以平衡模型訓練與原創保護，無須另設過度限制性的立法。
detail.en: The Electronic Frontier Foundation filed an amicus brief arguing that existing fair use principles properly balance AI training with creator rights without needing restrictive copyright overhauls.

headline.zh: Python 3.15.0 Release Candidate 2 正式發布，進入開源套件相容性測試與最終 Bug 修復階段。
headline.en: Python 3.15.0 Release Candidate 2 released, entering final bugfix and wheel compatibility testing phase.

headline.zh: Nvidia DLSS 5 即將於 9 月 3 日發布，透過即時生成式 AI 畫面過濾大幅提升 RTX 50 系列顯卡畫質。
headline.en: Nvidia DLSS 5 arrives September 3rd, introducing real-time generative video filters for RTX 50-series GPUs.

headline.zh: Sequoia 育成之 IT 故障預測新創 Empirik 獲得 2,100 萬美元融資正式出道。
headline.en: Sequoia-incubated IT outage prediction startup Empirik launches with $21 million in funding.

headline.zh: AI Agent 安全監控平台 AIR 完成 5,000 萬美元融資，主打 Agent 技能與擴充模組漏洞審查。
headline.en: AI Agent security startup AIR raises $50M to vet skills and add-ons used by enterprise agents.
